summaryZh: Murphy 实验室研究健康结局及教育培训，关注成本效果与比较效果分析。研究也发展面向放射肿瘤科医师的培训工具。

evidence.quote: Dr. Jim Murphy Dr. Murphy is an Associate Professor and Associate Director of the Center of Precision Radiation Medicine. A nationally-recognized leader in Health Outcomes Research with a particular interest in cost-effectiveness and comparative effectiveness analyses, he is also involved in education and training research. He is a recent recipient of a 5-year R-18 Grant from the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ) focused on developing innovative training tools for practicing radiation oncologists. Support Dr. Murphy’s research is supported in part by a 5-year $1.94M Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ) grant.
